### 8.2 Your Rights (GDPR)  
You have the right to:
- **Access:** Request copy of your personal data
- **Correction:** Correct inaccurate data
- **Erasure:** Request deletion (with exceptions for legal holds)
- **Portability:** Get your data in portable format  
**Contact:** dpo@firstuk.bank (Data Protection Officer)

raw_entities.description: Customer right to request deletion of their personal data, subject to legal hold exceptions and other GDPR Article 17 limitations. FirstUK Bank may retain data where required by law or regulatory obligation.

raw_entities.name: Data Protection Officer
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's designated Data Protection Officer responsible for handling customer data rights requests and GDPR compliance inquiries. Customers may contact this role directly for data access, correction, erasure, and portability requests.
